title: Offer and the power of acceptance
shortTitle: Offer and the power of acceptance
summary: An offer communicates willingness to bargain so that the recipient’s invited assent will conclude the exchange.
notes: Restatement § 24 and the accompanying commentary focus on whether further assent by the proposer is contemplated. A price quotation, advertisement, order, or document titled “proposal” must be read in context. Lefkowitz’s limited first-come offer differs from an invitation for customers to place orders. International Filter shows why preparing a form does not necessarily make its drafter the offeror.
